summary: The empty initial QA list is a valid structural defect and will be repaired with one Issue-grounded scope confirmation question.

items.title: 1. Empty initial QA list
items.rationale: The review contract requires at least one initial QA entry before answers exist, and a single scope-confirmation question can be added without introducing a new design decision.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[] is empty; Issue #432 explicitly fixes the eligible semantic_findings behavior and excludes plan-gate retry, reset, rewind, and non-semantic recovery.
